name: Lyrics
author: ryuhzk
description: Show synchronized lyrics for the current MPRIS track in the Omarchy bar and over the desktop.

barWidget.description: Current lyric line with a full synchronized lyrics panel.

schema.label: Bar width
schema.description: Maximum width of the lyric line in the bar.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: Width of the full lyrics panel in layout units.

schema.label: Lyrics offset (milliseconds)
schema.description: Positive values advance the displayed lyric; negative values delay it.

schema.label: Show track when lyrics are missing
Desktop lyrics
schema.description: Show the current and next line over the desktop while a track with lyrics is playing. It is click-through and disappears when playback stops.

schema.label: Desktop lyric size
schema.description: Pixel size of the current line. The upcoming line is drawn smaller.

schema.label: Distance from the bottom
schema.description: How far the lyrics sit above the bottom edge of the screen.
